# KOMOLA

> KOMOLA is an agri-tech platform connecting agricultural sellers and buyers through POS, digital receipts, purchase rewards, and market intelligence.

## Public pages

- [KOMOLA home](https://komola.in/): Overview of the KOMOLA agri-tech platform.
- [Privacy](https://komola.in/privacy): Privacy information for KOMOLA users.
- [Privacy requests](https://komola.in/privacy/requests): Submit or manage a privacy request.
- [Sign in](https://komola.in/login): Sign in to the KOMOLA platform.
